# Reader guide {#sec-reader-guide}

This manual is a consolidated, end-user oriented guide built from the content in the C5-DEC manual pages.

## Who this manual is for

This version is optimized for users who already know the platform and need quick access to module workflows, commands, and troubleshooting paths.

## How to navigate this document

Use this flow for fast task completion:

1. Read _Installation and workspace setup_ in @sec-installation only when you need to set up or repair an environment.
2. Use _quick start and interfaces_ in @sec-quick-start for CLI, TUI, and GUI launch paths.
3. Jump to _Module guides_ in @sec-modules for feature-specific workflows.
4. Use _Troubleshooting_ in @sec-troubleshooting when commands or environments fail.
5. Keep _Command reference_ in @sec-command-reference open for copy/paste operations.

## Interfaces at a glance

C5-DEC provides three primary interfaces:

- CLI for scriptable and automatable workflows.
- TUI for keyboard-driven interactive operation in a terminal.
- GUI for browser-based exploration and checklist workflows.

The manual content also documents third-party GUI usage patterns through Visual Studio Code, Zettlr, and Firefox integration paths.
